base: Frozen S04 final sources, nine production simulation files differ, production audio unchanged. No Git commit.

source.boundary: S04 final frozen sources plus eight modified simulation files and one local-query helper. Audio experiment remains diagnostic-only, no production audio change.

diagnosticRevision.reason: R2 manual allied maxHp mutation caused native wound-preserving stat refresh to zero patients. R3 leaves maxima native and resets diagnostic wounds to 25% before each real tick, disabling resets before 900-step tail and audio lifecycle. QA now asserts full 120/900 ticks, battle phase and living recipients. All production files and existing CPU benchmark input bundles unchanged.

methods: Whole run/status/equipment/event state and observation receipts compared.
Same-tick source/recipient mutation cases; no cross-tick target caching.

Eight Worlds each advance 180 real fixed steps; allied maxima remain native, diagnostic wounds set to 25% before each tick, every allied recipient remains alive and phase remains battle. Enemy pressure fixtures retain parked high health.

cpu.method: Alternating same-process production functions. Support timings include equal target HP/energy/event reset; status timing excludes queue construction. Synthetic target density, not FPS.

battleCpu.method: 16 wounded allied recipients plus 300 parked high-health enemies and relevant native support source. Local CPU, same-process 12 alternating pairs of 200 calls after 12 warmups. Eight complete state/observation pairs exact. Distinct from the 300-allied-recipient stress test; not natural gameplay or whole-game FPS.

audioExperiment.scope: Actual AudioEffects.update JavaScript with instrumented AudioContext nodes. Existing production source unchanged; experimental method only reuses the per-update ID Set. Not audio decoding, GPU or audible/hardware timing.

audioBaseline.method: Actual decoded AudioBuffer/AudioContext nodes through the production audio service. Headless checks prove node lifecycle, not human listening.

audioCandidate.method: Actual decoded AudioBuffer/AudioContext nodes through the production audio service. Headless checks prove node lifecycle, not human listening.

browser.captureMethod: Copy the already-rendered fixed scene while temporarily suspending duplicate WebGL submissions; restore renderer before further steps or all timing windows.

decisions.result: Expiry tickets carry their exact map key; pop verifies key plus serial instead of scanning map values. 4096 refreshed tickets / 512 live entries retained on both sides, so this is lookup CPU improvement, not queue compaction or lower memory. Serialized active status and refresh/restore semantics unchanged.

Stable bounded first-N support selection reads live bodies per call. Preserve the original health or shield ratio/ID, old-target +0.08 preference, zero-energy movement target, line/visibility and original heal order. No cross-tick recipient cache or scan frequency change. Small-army regressions retained; guardian-area candidate reverted.

Regeneration recipients skipped when no eligible native regeneration source, full-health recipients skipped; blood/barrier/plague/entry cleanup still run. Infection recipient scans skipped when no pool pulse is due, without skipping expiry/revival. Barrier-only support avoids unused mine enemy list. Broader source precollection reverted.

Only immutable effect-ID to first SOURCE_WEAPONS definition is indexed. Nonempty talents, ability, owner/team, mode, hero/elite and tactical changes remain live recomputation; no dynamic stat cache added. 26 weapon effect and 21 dynamic control checks exact.

Production audio unchanged. Actual update measured on 301 entities with 0/1/4/30 healers; Set-reuse experiment too small/inconsistent to adopt. 32 instrumented node lifecycle comparisons and nine actual decoded AudioContext stages per browser side pass. Existing healer loops separate from ordinary 12-voice ceiling, not newly limited. Stats/telemetry remain pending under U04.

items.resolution: R3 diagnostic leaves health/shield maxima native and resets wounds before each tick until stop. Runner asserts living patients, battle phase and full 120/900 steps. Both sides rerun as baseline-2/candidate-2. Prior raw reports and all images retained; R2/R3 production inputs exact. Node eight-World replay also strengthened to retain native allied maxima and assert living recipients each tick; all 850 checks re-pass in equivalence-r4.log.

negativeMeasurements.note: Unchanged guardian and empty-support controls have ordinary measurement variation; no benefit attributed. 16-recipient elite medical without background enemies and Swann/Artanis with 300 enemies show regressions, preserved rather than generalized from 300-allied-recipient stress results.

limitations: 300 allied wounded recipients are an extreme selection-pressure case, distinct from the separate 16-allied/300-enemy case. Local CPU is not whole-game FPS.
Browser samples are one ordered baseline/candidate pair, not an alternating replicated whole-game speedup experiment. Frozen rendering cannot establish simulation savings.
Only immutable weapon lookup is cached; dynamic talent/stat computation remains an unchanged control.
Status heap retains all refresh tickets; no queue memory compression or bounded-heap claim.
Actual decoded AudioContext node start/stop is verified, not audible quality or human listening. Audio experiment uses instrumented nodes and excludes decoding/hardware latency.

Diagnostic placement, repeated 25% allied wounds before native ticks, parked enemies, fixed-step preparation and post-timing audio clock adjustment are not natural gameplay or full-content 60 FPS acceptance.
U04 statistics/telemetry untouched and remains pending; A01 only five related review conclusions updated.
